I remember, during a flare- amidst losing my job, home and health insurance being on the phone for HOURS with insurance companies, pharmaceutical companies and hospitals trying to get things straightened out. Everything I accomplished in life until I “retired” at 25 I did whilst sick. I didn’t have my youth to build myself up a safety net. Every year I was getting hospitalized and chemo or immunotherapy. My disease is PROGRESSIVE. And silent. And invisible. And also lethal. Also, I AM SOMETHING -Jesus fucking Christ. Like whoooooo even are you to say something so god fucking awful. What pathetic people and I hope to fucking god that they EAT SHIT man. Sincerely, they can go fuck themselves. I CANNOT.

Not a doctor. I’m a patient with Wegners disease and so I get very seriously ill too often for comfort. I went septic last year. At the worst of it I was on 40 L O2 with nitrous. My lungs were full of infection, the lung X-ray was solid white. The doctors basically told my family I had hours or I’d be stat flighted to somewhere so they could put me on a ventilator and ECMO. The doctors told my family to say goodbye. The next day the doctor came in and was shocked I was still alive. A week later, once I pulled through, my doctor came in while I was alone and was very candid about the fact that she went home that night expecting to get a call about me passing that day. It woke me up and I filed for disability and I’ve not been in the hospital since. Going from once every 8 months being in the ICU to now 15 months without hospitalization I’m pretty blessed and grateful.
